json_ld.description: Everyone's favorite salsa verde, now in a dry blend that goes on basically anything. With cilantro, lime, green bell pepper, roasted green chile, and garlic and onion, shake this blend over tacos and eggs, whisk it into a marinade, or dust it on popcorn for a late-night cantina kick. Bright, zesty, and slightly spicy, you know (and love) this flavor.
json_ld.name: Cantina Verde Seasoning
